in_arabic.name: Neeku
in_arabic.long_meaning: Neeku هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. Derived from the Arabic root 'naka', meaning 'to suckle'. In Islamic culture, this name symbolizes the nurturing and protective nature of a mother towards her child.
